plan.title: Anywhere display bugs found by the 2026-11-04 screenshot run
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: One issue, one acceptance (each of five reported display bugs fixed with a test, plus after-fix screenshots on one PR). The code spans only src/lib and src/dashboard; the other counted subsystems are four single doc pages (configuration/remote-access.mdx, configuration/linked-machines.mdx, configuration/push-notifications.mdx, features/conversations.mdx) and the CI test list scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt, which the size lint counts one by one because they sit directly under a top-level directory. Every item is a small independent slice; splitting into sibling issues would duplicate the screenshot run five times.

narratives.Problem: The 2026-11-04 Anywhere screenshot run found five display bugs: the status card counts paired devices but not phones (0 while the list shows an Android phone); the app bar shows the raw deck key __no-project__ in its crumb and search placeholder; linked conversations with no title show their @<env-id>/<name> list name, and one shows an attachment file path as its title; the linked conversation Preview popover ignores Escape; the Anywhere section description is cut off at 1600 px and the Phone notifications empty state says 'No device' next to 'Overdeck app: 1 phone'.
narratives.Proposal: Fix each bug at its root, per the PRD at .pan/drafts/PAN-5000.md: one shared isPairedDeviceRecord predicate for the count, the list and revoke; pure app-bar label helpers that map the no-project sentinel to 'No project'; a server-side linkedRowTitle guard in linkedListRow; derivePromptTitle drops composer attachment reference lines; a document Escape listener in OpenPreviewPopover; a wrapping SettingsSection header without truncate; browser-specific empty-state copy. Every fix ships with a Vitest test and its doc line, and an isolated-dashboard Playwright spec captures after-fix screenshots into .pan/uat/pan-5000/.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No migration or rewrite of conversation titles already stored in any machine's database; only linked rows get the display guard.
- No change to how local conversation rows fall back to their name when their title is null.
- No change to src/dashboard/server/services/resource-discovery-shared.ts (issue-tree linked rows).
- No outside-click dismissal for the Preview popover and no change to any other popover.
- No change to the 'Move to project…' link on a linked conversation in the no-project deck.
- No second dashboard on the operator's live OVERDECK_HOME and no screenshots captured from :3011.
- The new Playwright spec is not added to the CI test:playwright script.
- No change to the AI title generator.

autoDecisions.summary: One exported isPairedDeviceRecord predicate ((kind ?? 'device') === 'device' || kind === 'phone') is used by the status count, the device list and revoke.
autoDecisions.rationale: The access-token module documents that a record with no kind is a device; one predicate keeps the count and the list from drifting again.

autoDecisions.summary: The count acceptance check is 'count equals active records in the list', never 'count equals list length'.
autoDecisions.rationale: DevicesPanel also lists revoked rows labelled 'Revoked … ago'.

autoDecisions.summary: The no-project deck shows the crumb 'No project' and the global search placeholder.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names 'No project' as acceptable, and search is not scoped to that deck, so 'Search No project…' would mislead.

autoDecisions.summary: Linked titles are fixed once on the server in linkedListRow, with a guard for null, blank and leading-absolute-path titles.
autoDecisions.rationale: Every renderer (desktop list, panel header, machine banner, phone list) reads the merged row, and an owner on an older version keeps sending path titles.

autoDecisions.summary: derivePromptTitle removes whole lines matching ^@<absolute path>$ and returns '' when nothing is left.
autoDecisions.rationale: That is the composer's attachment prefix format (ComposerFooter.tsx lines 493-496); callers already skip an empty derived title and the AI title still runs.

autoDecisions.summary: The Preview popover gets Escape only, not outside-click dismissal.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for Escape; outside-click is not requested (Karpathy: no unrequested features).

autoDecisions.summary: The truncation is fixed in the shared SettingsSection header with flex-wrap and no truncate class.
autoDecisions.rationale: The description text is short; four shrink-0 action buttons take the row. Wrapping changes nothing where the header already fits.

autoDecisions.summary: Screenshots come from a Playwright spec on the isolated dashboard with page.route mocks; linked rows in the mock are produced by the real mergeConversationRows. Screens 15/16 (linked panel) have an implementation checkpoint: if the panel does not render from REST mocks, the PR lists them for recapture after deploy.
autoDecisions.rationale: The fixed build is not on :3011 until merge, and a second dashboard on the live OVERDECK_HOME is forbidden.

items.title: Count phones in the Anywhere paired-devices total

expected_outputs: anywhere-status-route.test.ts and pairing.test.ts pass, including the new device+phone count case

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. Add `export function isPairedDeviceRecord(record: Pick<PublicAccessTokenRecord, 'kind'>): boolean` returning `(record.kind ?? 'device') === 'device' || record.kind === 'phone'` to src/lib/access-tokens.ts after listActiveRecordsOfKind. Use it in anywhere.ts line 116 (`records.filter((record) => isPairedDeviceRecord(record) && !record.revokedAt).length`, update the header bullet) and in pairing.ts line 180 (list filter) and line 199 (revoke lookup). Extend anywhere-status-route.test.ts: one device, one phone (phoneKey 'ab'.repeat(32), a UUID v4 clientId, scopes without admin/forward), one revoked device, one token → devices { active: 2 }; assert the predicate per kind. Replace configuration/remote-access.mdx line 206 with the PRD's 'Paired devices' bullet.

When the routes run, anywhere.ts, the GET /api/devices filter and the DELETE /api/devices/:id lookup in pairing.ts all apply isPairedDeviceRecord, and neither route file contains an inline kind === 'phone' check

narrative.Action: PRD WI-8 and decision D-10. Write src/dashboard/frontend/tests/pan-5000-anywhere-display.spec.ts on startIsolatedDashboard (pattern: pan-4445-anywhere-devices.spec.ts and pan-2355-mobile.spec.ts), using page.route mocks: **/api/anywhere/status ({ devices: { active: 1 } }) and **/api/devices (one active phone) for Settings → Anywhere at 1600x1000; the No project deck for the crumb; **/api/conversations built by calling the real mergeConversationRows with linked records titled null and '/Users/op/.overdeck/conversation-attachments/c1/a.png' (desktop list and the /m phone list at 390x844); the Preview popover after Escape; **/api/push/status with no web-push subscriptions and native.phones 1. Run npm run build first. Never point at :3011 or the live OVERDECK_HOME. Do not add the spec to the test:playwright script. Copy the PNGs to .pan/uat/pan-5000/, commit them, and link each from the PR body. Implementation checkpoint: if the linked conversation panel title bar does not render from REST mocks, capture the other screens and list screens 15/16 in the PR body as 'recapture after deploy'. Never add test.skip, skipIf or .only.
